name: Kajal Jha
title: Data Analyst | Power BI | SQL | Python | Advanced Excel
tagline: Solving business problems through data, dashboards, automation, and AI-driven solutions.
bio: I am a Data Analyst with 2.7 years of experience in Market Research and Customer Experience Management, specializing in Business Intelligence, Process Automation, Dashboard Development, and Data Analytics. Throughout my career, I have designed automated reporting systems, workflow automation solutions, and interactive dashboards that reduce manual effort and improve business efficiency. My expertise spans Power BI, SQL, Python, Advanced Excel, Google Sheets, and Google Apps Script, enabling me to build scalable, data-driven solutions that empower organizations to make informed decisions. Beyond analytics, I actively leverage AI-powered tools to accelerate analysis, automate repetitive tasks, and deliver smarter business solutions. I believe the future of analytics lies in combining Data, Automation, and AI to create measurable business impact.
mission: To bridge the gap between business challenges and data-driven decision-making by building intelligent analytics, automation, and AI-powered solutions that improve efficiency and create measurable value.
vision: To become a trusted Analytics Leader who leverages Data, Automation, and AI to help organizations make faster, smarter, and more strategic business decisions.
